discussion.body: Ysolde Rhea. Main-side. Tierso, Temple of Life. Cleric-alchemist. Optional Act 1 guest at Iron's Gate (heals the heat-death survivors, then leaves). Locks in Act 6. Death crisis: blight ward at Life if the party splits to Light too early. Default lives. Contingency: Root Sigil from the altar; Maera or a Life remnant can carry the heal role at a lower ceiling. If she never guest-appeared in Act 1, Act 1 still plays.
